comment: Seeded bugs of et-7, one per claimed behaviour, in each language whose product code the item changes. Each is an exact replacement of `old` by `new` in `file`; `test` must fail with it and pass without it. Lean mutants are run on a rebuilt and temporarily pinned ve_service (the pin is restored after).

mutants.behaviour: FOLLOWABLE needs a certificate over Background_baseAlt(E''') ++ Fill_T ++ Gamma (plan seeded bug 1: Fill_T dropped)
mutants.old:
decodePackageU s environment norms units (j.getObjValD "package") "followable"
      (backgroundBaseAltU s.src.A s.unspec ++ s.src.A.Γ)
mutants.new:
decodePackageU s environment norms units (j.getObjValD "package") "followable"
      (backgroundBaseAlt s.src.A ++ s.src.A.Γ)

mutants.behaviour: an UNDECIDED alternative is never rendered clear (plan seeded bug 2)
UNSETTLED only from two validated fillings with opposite answers (plan seeded bug 3)
mutants.old:
fillValid ⟨inlineTree A, unspec⟩ M (refill F C S) &&
        (clearFU A unspec).eval (M.withFill (refill F C S)) (tupleVal [r, a])

mutants.behaviour: CONFLICT-FREE over BaseAdmissibleAltU, the slot premises included (SR-A3)
mutants.old: decodePackageU s environment norms units (packages.getObjValD t.1) t.1 (backgroundBaseAltU s.src.A s.unspec)
mutants.new: decodePackageU s environment norms units (packages.getObjValD t.1) t.1 (VE.NormDefaults.Wire.baseBackgroundU s.U)

mutants.behaviour: the decoder records the unspecified predicates (SR-A2)
the alt-certificate producer binds Lean's premise order (plan seeded bug: layer premises before slot premises)
mutants.old:
bound = [*(x["ast"] for x in elaborated["background"]), *(x["ast"] for x in elaborated["alternatives"]),
             *(x["ast"] for x in elaborated["premises"]), *premises]
mutants.new:
bound = [*(x["ast"] for x in elaborated["background"]), *(x["ast"] for x in elaborated["premises"]),
             *(x["ast"] for x in elaborated["alternatives"]), *premises]

mutants.behaviour: the Python mirror of the deleted refusal stays deleted (plan 2.11)
